mediaCoverage.title: Ayushman card camp held in Daharauli village, hundreds benefit
mediaCoverage.description: Dainik Bhaskar, Lucknow (18 April 2026). A special camp in Gram Panchayat Daharauli, Nathnagar block, Sant Kabir Nagar, helped villagers register for Ayushman cards.

mediaCoverage.title: New hope for rural women: breast cancer screening begins in Sant Kabir Nagar
mediaCoverage.description: Hindi daily (6 April 2026). Screening launched at the Kathaicha centre, with a street play (nukkad natak) explaining breast cancer symptoms, checks and prevention.

mediaCoverage.title: DigiSwasthya Foundation starts breast cancer screening in rural Uttar Pradesh
mediaCoverage.description: Dainik Bhaskar, Sant Kabir Nagar (5 April 2026). CSR-backed breast cancer screening project launched at the Kali Road, Kathaicha centre with IRCTC's Sanjay Gaur as chief guest.

mediaCoverage.title: Free Ayushman camp at Gram Sabha Manpur Bhartolia draws hundreds of villagers
mediaCoverage.description: Dainik Bhaskar, Sant Kabir Nagar. A free camp in Nathnagar block helped villagers make new Ayushman Bharat cards and update old ones.

mediaCoverage.title: Nagpur Municipal Corporation renews partnership with DigiSwasthya Foundation
mediaCoverage.description: Dainik Mahasagar, Nagpur (26 February 2026). Three-year renewal to run eight telemedicine centres in the city, after 13,247 patients were checked last year.

mediaCoverage.title: Cycle rally mobilises villagers towards cancer awareness
mediaCoverage.description: Times of India, Lucknow (World Cancer Day, 4 February 2026). Cycle rally and awareness programme by the DigiSwasthya Telemedicine Centre, Itaunja, with Rama College and local panchayats.

mediaCoverage.title: Rama College holds cancer awareness programme with DigiSwasthya
mediaCoverage.description: Vidhan Kesari, Lucknow (World Cancer Day 2026). Street play and cultural performances carried the message of timely treatment.

mediaCoverage.title: World Cancer Day event at Kamala Kutir, Itaunja
mediaCoverage.description: Sandauli Times, Lucknow (World Cancer Day 2026). Over 100 villagers, students and representatives joined the DigiSwasthya cycle rally and awareness programme.

mediaCoverage.title: Cancer awareness campaign held by DigiSwasthya telemedicine centre in Itaunja
mediaCoverage.description: KPPN, Lucknow (World Cancer Day 2026). Awareness campaign and cycle rally at the Karua Panchayat Bhawan.

mediaCoverage.title: Telemedicine facility at Gorewada Primary Health Centre inaugurated
mediaCoverage.description: The Hitavada, Nagpur (1 February 2025). Nagpur Municipal Corporation unveiled a telemedicine facility managed by DigiSwasthya Foundation, funded through WCL's CSR.

mediaCoverage.title: Specialist doctors' advice now at NMC dispensary: telemedicine launched at Gorewada
mediaCoverage.description: Hindi daily, Nagpur (February 2025). Telemedicine service started at Gorewada health centre by DigiSwasthya Foundation with NMC.
